messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: export stan functions to R?
parts:
Hi!

Is it possible to export stan core functions to R easily (without redefining user function proxies)?

Background: I am using excessively the user functions in my models. To ease posterior predictions I want to be able to execute the directives in the transformed data block of the Stan program in my R session (then the input data gets processed such that I can directly call the Stan internal user functions of my model). This works quite nice except that I have to redefine those Stan internal functions to make the code work in R (rep_array, rep_vector, ...). Most of these functions are easy to define quickly, but doing this more stringent and using the vanilla Stan functions would be nicer.

BTW, this gives me a truly amazing system for simulating from my model, just awesome - all I need to do is to define a data set and then the rest is automatic.

Thanks!

Best,
Sebastian
